name: tool-forge-prelint-ast-grep
description: ast-grep lint rules for Atlassian Forge apps

scripts.check: npm run test && npm run lint && npm run format:check
scripts.lint:check: ast-grep scan --config sgconfig.recommended.yml && ast-grep scan --config sgconfig.strict.yml
scripts.lint:fix: echo 'ast-grep does not support auto-fix for these rules'
